title: * Adapt to pygobject change of GLib.Idle.set_callback parameters,
commit_message:
* Adapt to pygobject change of GLib.Idle.set_callback parameters,
  fixing crash and FTBFS (LP: #2146446)
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 7868220..333113d 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+unattended-upgrades (2.12ubuntu8) resolute; urgency=medium
+
+  * Adapt to pygobject change of GLib.Idle.set_callback parameters,
+    fixing crash and FTBFS (LP: #2146446)
+
+ -- Alessandro Astone <alessandro.astone@canonical.com>  Thu, 26 Mar 2026 12:47:31 +0100
+
 unattended-upgrades (2.12ubuntu7) resolute; urgency=medium
 
   * unattended-upgrade: cherry-pick upstream change to fix flake8 tests
diff --git a/test/test_postpone.py b/test/test_postpone.py
index a869223..2d40e82 100755
--- a/test/test_postpone.py
+++ b/test/test_postpone.py
@@ -92,7 +92,7 @@ class PostponeClient(threading.Thread):
         handler_id = self.proxy.connect('g-signal', on_signal)
 
         source = GLib.idle_source_new()
-        source.set_callback(lambda _: self.started_sem.release())
+        source.set_callback(self.started_sem.release)
         source.attach(self.thread_context)
 
         self.loop.run()
diff --git a/unattended-upgrade b/unattended-upgrade
index 22c5a32..583b297 100755
--- a/unattended-upgrade
+++ b/unattended-upgrade
@@ -1974,7 +1974,7 @@ def install_or_postpone(cache,             # type: UnattendedUpgradesCache
 
     def run_in_thread(callback):
         source = GLib.idle_source_new()
-        source.set_callback(lambda _: callback())
+        source.set_callback(callback)
         source.attach(thread_context)
 
     t = threading.Thread(target=dbus_thread)
